title: Distance betwen SMS boluses not applied
symptom: Remote SMS bolus attempts failed with error messages, and the boluses were not shown in the graph or parent app until the app was restarted, after which they appeared as delivered. The pump reported IOB of 0.51U and later 11U, leading to a severe hypoglycemia event.
cause: Bad communication with pump, possibly due to distance between pump and phone. The phone could initiate a connection and start bolus, but then the connection broke, causing AAPS to report unsuccessful bolus.
fix: No solution for the underlying issue. The error message was improved in a commit (03377bc1dc8b6b3c0e105e646ff1ca6ff7c2cc5b).
evidence_quote: The primary reason is bad communication with pump maybe because of distance between pump and phone. In this case phone was able to to initiate a connection to the pump and start bolus. Then connection was broken and AAPS has to report unsuccessful bolus.
